info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Servicing By Param1-spec
info.description: The Servicing Mandate Management API provides an efficient way to modify servicing mandates based on specific parameters. This endpoint allows authorized users to update existing servicing mandates identified by 'param1'. It is particularly useful for banks and financial institutions looking to adjust servicing agreements in real time. By enabling seamless updates, this API supports financial service providers in maintaining compliance and enhancing customer satisfaction through responsive service management.

patch.description: This endpoint allows developers to update the details of a specific servicing mandate identified by its unique resource identifier. Ensure that the necessary fields are provided in the request body to execute the update successfully.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the details necessary to update the servicing mandate identified by RES-100045. Ensure that all required fields are correctly filled out to successfully complete the update operation.
